feeds.title: Reductress
feeds.description: The first and only satirical women's magazine, Reductress was founded in 2013 by Beth Newell and Sarah Pappalardo. The mission of Reductress is to take on the outdated perspectives and condescending tone of popular women's media.

feeds.title: Lamebook
feeds.description: Lamebook is a fun humor blog that allows us to all share and marvel at the funny, ridiculous, and outright crazy posts that can be found on your favorite social networking site.

feeds.title: Improbable Research
feeds.description: Research that makes people LAUGH and then THINK. We collect research that makes people laugh, then think. We hope to spur people's curiosity, and to raise the question: How do you decide what's important and what's not, and what's real and what's not — in science and everywhere else?

feeds.title: News Biscuit
feeds.description: NewsBiscuit was launched by John O'Farrell with the noble aims of eradicating global poverty, creating a lasting peace in the Middle East and providing a daily dose of humour to bored people at work.

feeds.title: The Chaser
feeds.description: The Chaser is a satirical media empire that publishes in print, online, radio, television, and Christmas crackers. Striving for mediocrity in a world of excellence

feeds.title: The Borowitz Report
feeds.description: The Borowitz Report is an award-winning news satire column read by millions in 175 countries.

feeds.title: Weekly World News
feeds.description: If you care about the future of our world, this is the only place on earth you can learn about UFO activity, classified government cover-ups, Bigfoot movements, Secret science experiments paid for by pharmaceutical companies, Cryptic findings Register online to be part of our world!

feeds.title: The Daily Mash
feeds.description: The Daily Mash is a satirical website that publishes spoof articles, i.e. it is all made-up and is not intended, in any way whatsoever, to be taken as factual.

feeds.title: Duffel Blog
feeds.description: Since 2012, we have poked fun at generals, lieutenants, and everyone in between while helping military members and civilians think critically about national security through satire and humor. Duffel Blog is the first and only satirical news outlet devoted to the U.S. military community. We are an independent, reader-supported publication.

feeds.title: The Lemon Press
feeds.description: The Lemon Press is the University of York's student-run satire magazine—print and digital—riffing humorously on campus life, politics, and beyond since 2009.

feeds.title: The Poke
feeds.description: The Poke is a UK-based humor site, featuring trending videos, tweets, news, and entertainment in various categories. The content covers topics such as politics, celebrities, life, entertainment, sports, animals, and science.

feeds.title: The Fauxy
feeds.description: The Fauxy is an entertainment media company that connects with young, intelligent, and diverse audiences that are shaping our future. Through fictitious, thought-provoking comedy and high-impact storytelling, we aim to start a conversation around subjects that are usually viewed as taboo for today's youth.

feeds.title: The Unger Review
feeds.description: The Daily Bonnet is a Mennonite satirical news site from the heart of the Bible belt. We publish fictitious content revolving around real people.

feeds.title: Arnold Zwicky's Blog » Parody
feeds.description: Posts about Parody written by arnold zwicky

feeds.title: Eat Drink Films » Parody
feeds.description: Posts about parody written by garyedf

feeds.title: Click Hole
feeds.description: ClickHole is the latest and greatest online social experience filled with the most clickable, irresistibly shareable content anywhere on the internet. The site is meant to parody the likes of BuzzFeed, Upworthy and ViralNova.

feeds.title: Walking Eagle News
feeds.description: Walking Eagle News is a satirical Indigenous news website focusing on a lot of indigenous topics. Launched in 2017 by Tim Fontaine, WEN is a leader in the world of fictional Indigenous journalism. Our many stories, while often drawn from real life or ripped from the headlines, are entirely made-up and point to a deeper social issue in a comedic way.

feeds.title: Cracked
feeds.description: Cracked is an American satire and humor website that began as a print magazine in 1958. The website was founded in 2005 by Jack O'Brien, and it has since become one of the most popular humor websites in the world. Cracked is known for its irreverent and often offensive humor, which has been praised by some and criticized by others.

feeds.title: The Onion
feeds.description: The Onion is America's Finest News Source.

feeds.title: Urban Dictionary Tumblr
feeds.description: I am a dictionary with millions of definitions written by you.

feeds.title: The Spoof
feeds.description: The Spoof is one of the web's leading satirical and spoof newspapers and magazines with the web's largest social group of fake news comedy writers. It brings you all the latest fake celebrity gossip and entertainment, current affairs, sports, technology, science, and business news.

feeds.title: The End Times
feeds.description: The End Times is a news satire and parody site presented from a Christian worldview perspective. We aim to engage in the culture-shaping realms of satire and parody in a manner that not only makes people laugh, but prompts them to think critically and, more importantly, biblically, about the issues, causes and personalities shaping current events.
